rapport_notes: Excellent engagement throughout — lemon tree banter, patient troubleshooting on packing/box questions, felt like a real conversation.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Before I go over locations do you have any questions or concerns that you want answered on this call specifically" — asked before any logistics probing began.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered "No, no, I'm just trying to get quotes from different companies right now" — no concern raised.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "It's kind of like a lot of plus and minuses... I would add time for the elevators and walks, but then you only have that five minute drive... you also don't have a couch" — window/factors framing tied to her specific move.

top_strength: Walked through a genuinely complex packing-vs-self-pack pricing decision (with two different ranges) clearly and patiently, then made an explicit close ask that landed the booking.
coaching_note: Communication (day-before call / named crew lead / inbox updates) is never covered anywhere — the one clean miss in an otherwise strong call.
